THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FOLK & LANDSCAPE
055
STUDY 022
Red Embroidered Bodice by the Sea
Rights check
Source: 24600.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark brown hair in a
loose side braid, with strands blowing across her face,
wears a red embroidered high-necked bodice over a
white gathered blouse with puff sleeves. Red ribbon
ties hang from her shoulders, and gold drop earrings
catch the light. She stands on a windswept shoreline
under an overcast sky. Her expression is steady and
serious. Soft, muted daylight, a palette of crimson,
cream, and sandy gold. Timeless and windswept, in the
style of a film photograph.
Earthy, windswept, timeless
WORKING NOTES
- The red embroidery against the cream blouse is the
defining contrast.
- Keep the overcast sky to maintain the muted palette.
